_readme: TEMPORARY probe: Kimi K2.6 at tp4 (was tp8) to verify it boots on MI300X.
Root cause of the tp8 baseline_failed: Kimi has 64 attention heads; tp8 = 8
heads/GPU, NOT a multiple of 16, so sglang falls back to the triton backend +
'cannot unpack non-iterable ForwardMetadata object'). tp4 = 16 heads/GPU,
which satisfies the aiter MLA kernel (the exact same path DeepSeek-R1 tp8 =
128/8 = 16 takes cleanly). Single-variable test: only tp changed. Delete after dispatch.

candidates.label: Kimi K2.6 tp4
candidates.note: tp4 probe @ core42-hyperloom: 64 heads/4=16 -> aiter MLA, avoids the triton fused-decode bug that killed tp8
